newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil futures market launches new forex contract.
newsitem.headline: Brazil futures market launches new forex contract.

text.p: Brazilian futures exchange Bolsa de Mercadorias e Futuros (BM&F) will launch a new foreign exchange futures contract, possibly on November 1, a BM&F spokeswoman said.

The monthly contract will trade daily on the difference between the DI interest rate and the variation in the commercial real-dollar exchange rate, known in Brazil as the "cupom," or coupon, she said. The DI interest rate is set by central bank formula.
The new contract will expire on the first working day of every month, she added.
The BM&F will release details of the new contract in the next few days, the spokeswoman said.
